profile_name: Multi-Case Compilation — Psychological Cold Open, 4–6 Cases in One Long Video
based_on: A faceless English channel publishing 60–120 minute videos that chain several serial-killer cases (~16,500 words in the 2-hour example). No names, places or cases from the original are kept.
best_for: 1–2 hour videos: 'N cases nobody talks about', 'N killers from [state]', themed collections

secondary: socially critical when the system failed certain victims

point_of_view.narration: third-person past tense, with occasional present-tense framing ('There is a photograph of…')
point_of_view.viewer_address: a single 'Let's get into it.' after each case opener; 'you' only in reflective lines

audience_addressing_style: invisible narrator with brief direct transitions between cases

hook_style.type: philosophical premise about the human mind, then a photograph that lies
hook_style.formula: [A general truth about how people hide what they are]. [Today's case takes that to its furthest point]. Let's get into it. There is a photograph of [person] taken [when]. [What he looks like: ordinary, forgettable]. He was not that man. [Years and place of the hidden crimes]. This is the story of the man they called [nickname or description], and by the end you will understand why.
hook_style.length_words: 150–250 for the first case; each later case opens with its own 60–120 word mini-hook

narrative_structure.type: anthology: one premise → 4–6 self-contained case chapters → closing reflection
case_chapter_template: a. Mini-hook: the ordinary face versus the hidden truth.
b. Birth and childhood, the first warning signs.
c. Early offences and missed chances.
d. The crimes in chronological order, focused on the victims as people.
e. How police connected them; social failures (which victims were ignored and why).
f. Arrest, trial or death, sentence.
g. A closing paragraph on what made this person 'truly terrifying': the normal life around the crimes.
narrative_structure.transitions: each chapter ends on a reflective line and the next opens with a new mini-hook, with no recap
narrative_structure.ending: the last case's reflection doubles as the video's ending; no long outro

pacing.overall: steady, documentary, with short sentence clusters at each reveal

sentence_style.mix: short declaratives in clusters ('He was not that man.'), medium descriptive sentences for biography

language_style.register: clear documentary English with psychological vocabulary explained simply
language_style.social_context: names systemic bias or neglect when documented (whose disappearances were ignored)

characters.perpetrators: seen through the gap between public mask and private reality
characters.victims: named, with lives and families, especially those society overlooked
characters.families_and_detectives: voices of the long fight for attention

dialogue.use: short documented quotes from families, prosecutors, investigators

emotional_tone.arc: unsettling premise → dread → anger at neglect → grim resolution, repeated per case

common_devices: naming overlooked victims and why they were overlooked

call_to_action_style.closing: optional single line: 'If you want more cases like these, subscribe; new episodes every week.'

visual_cue_prompts.case_open: the ordinary photo with a slow push-in, then a darkened duplicate
visual_cue_prompts.biography: period stock and photos, map of the region
visual_cue_prompts.crimes: victims' photos in a respectful grid, map pins, timeline
visual_cue_prompts.chapter_cards: case number and name on a dark case-file card

safety_and_compliance: No sexual or torture detail; state the nature of crimes in one plain sentence.
Do not glamorise nicknames; use them once to identify.
Victims only with real photos; no AI likeness; no minors recreated.

script_formatting_rules.parts: The final script must be sectioned into 10 parts, each part at least 800 words.
script_formatting_rules.total_length: The full script must be 8,000+ words in total (for a 2-hour video: 14 parts and 16,000+ words, generated in two batches of 7 parts).
script_formatting_rules.no_headings: No section headings, no part numbers, no titles inside the text.
script_formatting_rules.no_line_breaks: No line breaks: the whole script is one continuous block of text.
script_formatting_rules.no_symbols: No underscores, no bullet points, no brackets, no stage directions, no visual cues, no comments.
script_formatting_rules.no_wrappers: No introductory statement and no closing statement outside the narration itself.
script_formatting_rules.delivery: Send the whole script in one batch, only the script text, with nothing before or after it.
